text:
maria: Quick sync — three short vignettes for the benchmark launch we're prototyping: 1) latency-first (low tail latency anchors) 2) cost-saver (tokens-to-$ reductions) 3) throughput-scale (peak throughput story). Attaching sketches and chart exports. Need picks for: social hero, webinar demo, and one data chart for the press tweet.

sam: Nice. Can you upload the actual chart exports? want the raw numbers to decide which headline lands.

maria: Uploaded: https://redwood-assets.s3/charts/vignette_1_latency.png and https://redwood-assets.s3/charts/vignette_2_cost.png and https://redwood-assets.s3/charts/vignette_3_throughput.png. TL;DR: cost-saver shows ~40% token cost reduction vs baseline for typical chat workload, latency-first cuts p95 from 380ms -> 120ms with the same model, throughput-scale shows 2.6x sustainable requests/sec on dedicated config.

leila: For enterprise outbound + SDRs I'd push latency-first + cost-saver. enterprise buyers keep asking "how fast AND cheap?"

aj: For webinar flow I'd demo throughput-scale early (easy load test live), then switch to cost-saver slide to close on ROI. demo script can show a single prompt path with batching on/off.

sam: Copy ideas: A) "Ship fast. Keep costs down." B) "Latency you can measure. Unit economics you can trust." Which is bolder?

maria: Proposal: Social hero A -> latency-first visual + copy A; Social hero B -> cost-saver visual + copy B. Webinar hero -> throughput-scale live demo, then a two-chart slide: latency vs cost.

leila: Agree with that flow. For press/analyst outreach pick the cost chart as the single-shareable stat (40% token cost reduction). It's the clearest ROI headline.

aj: Note for ops: when we claim 40% we need the benchmark appendix with seed prompts, model version, quantization settings, and batch size. I'll mock that up.

maria: Action items: 1) design to produce 2x hero PNGs (latency + cost) by Fri EOD — @design 2) webinar demo script + load script by Tue — @aj 3) benchmark appendix draft by Tue — @sam

ops-bot: Reminder: final art deadline set in Launch calendar: 2026-03-30 09:00 PT. Please update the event if any slippage.

sam: Quick check — A/B test plan for social: run both hero variants for 48 hrs, measure CTR -> MQL rate. ok? :thumbsup:

maria: Yep. We'll set the experiment and report back Monday morning. Thanks everyone.
